prompt:
A high-definition, 360-degree equirectangular photograph of A vibrant coral reef teeming with tropical fish, sea turtles, manta rays, and sunlight filtering through crystal clear turquoise water.
The perspective is from underwater, looking around a coral reef.
A seamless, spherical projection in a 2:1 aspect ratio.
Clear sky, bright daylight, ultra-realistic texture.

annotations.name: Vibrant Coral Reef
annotations.description: A diverse and colorful coral reef, teeming with various forms of hard and soft corals, dominates the left and central foreground.

annotations.name: School of Anthias
annotations.description: Numerous small, bright orange fish (likely Anthias) swarm near the water's shimmering surface on the left side.

annotations.name: School of Snappers
annotations.description: A tightly-knit school of bright yellow fish, possibly snappers, gracefully swims across the mid-right.

annotations.name: Sunbeams through Water
annotations.description: Dramatic rays of sunlight pierce through the water's surface on the upper right, illuminating the blue depths below.

annotations.name: Clear Blue Depths
annotations.description: The expansive and clear deep blue water stretches into the background, creating a sense of vastness and tranquility.

annotations.name: Clownfish and Anemone
annotations.description: A distinct orange and white clownfish is visible nestled within a host anemone among the vibrant coral formations.

annotations.name: Sandy Ocean Floor
annotations.description: Patches of bright, undisturbed sandy seafloor are visible between coral formations in the deeper, central-right background.
